repairs.what: Restored 10 amounts in the transcript that read as a chunk of panel markup instead of "$1xx" / "$2xx".
repairs.cause: An earlier patch script passed the transcript as a JavaScript replace() replacement string, so "$1" and "$2" were interpreted as capture groups (the opening and closing markup of the transcript panel).
repairs.evidence: The inserted text is exactly the panel markup; the surrounding sentence reads as a dollar amount ("pays over $100,000 a year", "$10,000 to $15,000"). Reversed by lib/episode-data.js repairDollarAmounts during the data-layer migration; counted and logged by scripts/extract-episodes.js.
repairs.confirmedBy: mechanical reversal of a known bug, no editorial judgement involved
